description: Switches the narrating voice of an existing project (all presenters; speed kept) and/or its pace. `voz` is an id from studio_listar_vozes: a catalogue voice, or one of the user’s own `minha-<id>` voices (only who trained or bought it can use it; checked again by Ania). `velocidade` (optional, alone or with voz): 0.79 very calm, 0.86 calm, 1 normal, 1.1 fast; own voices default to calm (0.86) until set. Applies from the next studio_renderizar; videos already rendered keep their voice. Free.

confirmar_genero.description: Only after the user confirmed a voice of the other gender than the avatar (the first call refuses with voice_gender_mismatch).

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

velocidade.description: Narration pace: 0.79 very calm, 0.86 calm, 1 normal, 1.1 fast.

name: studio_trocar_voz
title: Studio: switch a project’s voice
